# MM-P2-L2-HT02-S1 Lubrication and fluids - Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2

Revision: Rev D  
Plant: P2, line P2-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L2-HT02

Scope
This document defines lubrication and fluid requirements for EQ-P2-L2-HT02. It covers approved lubricant identification, critical fluid behavior during normal operation, and inspection acceptance criteria. Refer to QS-PROC-08 for quality verification and to SOP-P2-L2-01 and SOP-P2-L2-03 for operational interfaces and safe handling.

Tools
- Clean lint-free cloths
- Secondary containment trays compatible with approved lubricant
- Material Safety Data Sheet available per SOP-P2-L2-01

Procedure
- Verify system is in a safe state following SOP-P2-L2-01 and SOP-P2-L2-03 prior to any fluid handling.
- Confirm lubricant part number on container label matches approved inventory record. The lubricant part number for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is CFW-LUB-376.
- When topping or replacing lubricant, use secondary containment and absorbent materials per QS-PROC-08.
- Observe fluid behavior during initial system circulation. The quench delay maximum for Ring Rolling heat treat furnace #2 (EQ-P2-L2-HT02) is 16 seconds.
- Record lubricant lot code and MSDS reference in the equipment maintenance log referenced by SOP-P2-L2-03.

Acceptance criteria
- Lubricant identity in system matches CFW-LUB-376 and container labels match maintenance log entry.
- No leakage or pooling of lubricant outside secondary containment after procedure completion.
- System operation shows quench response consistent with recorded baseline. Measured quench delay does not exceed 16 seconds.
- Any deviation from acceptance criteria requires escalation in accordance with QS-PROC-08 and corrective action per SOP-P2-L2-01.

Related documentation
QS-PROC-08  
SOP-P2-L2-01  
SOP-P2-L2-03
